metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in Bryce Canyon National Park appear lower compared to Las Vegas during 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use VIIRS Nighttime Lights monthly composites for 2024 over two AOIs: a polygon approximating Bryce Canyon National Park and a polygon covering the Las Vegas urban area. Dataset: NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG; fallback to VCMCFG if empty. 2. Masking strategy: Nighttime lights monthly composites are already cloud-screened (VCM). No additional masking. 3. Logic: Compute 2024 median radiance (avg_rad). Validate collections, pixel counts, and means. If counts are zero -> C2; if no images -> C1; if mean is null/NaN -> C3. Compare means; if Bryce < Las Vegas -> A else B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const bryce = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-112.38, 37.38], [-112.38, 37.82], [-112.05, 37.82], [-112.05, 37.38], [-112.38, 37.38]] ]); const vegas = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-115.38, 35.98], [-115.38, 36.40], [-114.85, 36.40], [-114.85, 35.98], [-115.38, 35.98]] ]); const start = '2024-01-01'; const end = '2025-01-01'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check let datasetId = 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG'; let col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId).filterDate(start, end).select('avg_rad'); let size = await col.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { datasetId = 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG'; col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId).filterDate(start, end).select('avg_rad'); size = await col.size().getInfo(); } if (size === 0) { console.log('2024 images: 0'); console.log('C1'); return; } console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetId}, 2024 images: ${size}`); // 3. Processing (Median 2024) const img = col.median().select('avg_rad'); // 4. Counts and Means const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), true); const bryceStats = await img.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: bryce, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const vegasStats = await img.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: vegas, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const bCount = bryceStats['avg_rad_count']; const vCount = vegasStats['avg_rad_count']; const bMean = bryceStats['avg_rad_mean']; const vMean = vegasStats['avg_rad_mean']; if ((bCount === 0 || vCount === 0) || (bCount == null || vCount == null)) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if ([bMean, vMean].some(x => x === null || x === undefined || Number.isNaN(x) || !isFinite(x))) { console.log('Calculation failed (mean is null/NaN).'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Bryce px: ${bCount}, mean nW/cm^2/sr: ${bMean.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`LasVegas px: ${vCount}, mean nW/cm^2/sr: ${vMean.toFixed(3)}`); const ratio = bMean / (vMean === 0 ? 1e-9 : vMean); console.log(`Bryce/LasVegas ratio: ${ratio.toFixed(3)}`); // 5. Final Answer const result = bMean < vMean ? 'A' : 'B'; console.log(result); } catch (err) { console.log(`Error: ${err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
